@contextlib.contextmanager
def variant(name: str) -> Iterator[None]:
    with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
        if name == 'baseline':
            for module_name, module in tuple(sys.modules.items()):
                if module_name.startswith('flagquantum.') and module is not None:
                    for key, value in tuple(vars(module).items()):
                        if value is candidate:
                            stack.enter_context(patch.object(module, key, baseline))
        yield

def observe(case: tuple[int, str, str], workflow: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    width, family, topology = case
    bundle = Bundle(HARNESS / 'docs/implementation')
    acceptance = bundle.cases['ROUTE-GRID-08' if width == 8 else f'ROUTE-LINE-{width:02d}']
    config = workflow_configuration(workflow)
    adapter = load_adapter(SimpleNamespace(configuration={'options': {'sdk': config['sdk'], 'workflow': workflow, 'compiler_options': config}}))
    source = fixture(width, family, topology, '01' * 32)
    seed = bundle.plan['execution_profile']['compiler_seeds'][0]
    start = time.perf_counter()
    payload = adapter.execute('route', source, seed)
    seconds = time.perf_counter() - start
    metrics = routing(payload, source, None, acceptance, 0)
    assert payload['final_layout'] == list(range(width))
    normalized = json.dumps({key: payload[key] for key in ('operations', 'final_layout')}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False)
    return {'metrics': metrics, 'normalized_output_sha256': hashlib.sha256(normalized.encode()).hexdigest(), 'audit': dict(adapter.audit), 'seconds': seconds}

report: dict[str, Any] = {'implementation_commit': git(ROOT, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'), 'base_commit': BASE, 'source_commit': git(HARNESS, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'), 'scope': 'Inspected single-device shared macOS development controls, one numerical thread; no qualified timing, process RSS, prospective, SDK ranking or scalability claim', 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256((ROOT / SOURCE_PATH).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'baseline_source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(baseline_source.encode()).hexdigest(), 'driver': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'complete': False, 'rows': [], 'timing': [], 'memory': [], 'profiles': []}
